family_name.except: marriage or joining a clan (Shinobi Life and Core glue)

eye_color.except: a kekkei genkai shows itself (Sharingan, Byakugan) on its own

clan.except: marriage, a clan's invitation, or founding a clan

marks.note: face paint and chosen marks; scars the story gives stay

outfit.note: the wardrobe chest in your home holds every outfit you own; the tailor sells palettes and variants (100 to 600 ryo)

headwear.note: from Genin the forehead protector is one of them

clanless.blurb: Most of the Leaf belongs to no clan: civilians' children and shinobi of ordinary families. You start even with everyone and earn your place yourself.
means: An ordinary family name, on your papers
Every collection's hairstyles and the open colors
From Genin: one lesser technique from each clan where a friend reaches level 7
Clan lines play as the outsider's welcome test; a clan may invite you to join it later

senju.name: Senju
senju.blurb: The founders' clan: calm, generous, with a long memory. A living tree grows through their hall.
senju.technique: Wood Release: short-lived wooden barriers and binding roots
senju.quarter: A compound beside the Hokage Residence, under the Rock

uzumaki.name: Uzumaki
uzumaki.blurb: Few living members, a memorial shrine with the spiral crest, and the finest sealing tradition in the Leaf. Loud, warm, long-lived.
uzumaki.technique: Sealing chains and a deep chakra pool
uzumaki.quarter: A small compound next to the Senju, mostly a memorial

uchiha.name: Uchiha
uchiha.blurb: Proud, private and quick to take offence; they run the Military Police from their walled quarter at the village edge.
uchiha.technique: The Sharingan's sight: earlier warnings, wider parries, techniques learned by watching
uchiha.quarter: A walled compound on the village's outskirts

hyuga.name: Hyuga
hyuga.blurb: Formal and exact, split into a main house and a branch house. Every Hyuga has the pale eyes of the Byakugan.
hyuga.technique: Byakugan and the Gentle Fist: sight through walls, strikes that drain chakra
hyuga.quarter: A formal estate a short walk from the Residence

nara.name: Nara
nara.blurb: Unhurried strategists who keep the deer forest at the village edge. Old allies of the Akimichi and the Yamanaka.
nara.technique: Shadow Possession: your shadow holds a target to your movements
nara.quarter: A plain compound against the clan's deer forest

akimichi.name: Akimichi
akimichi.blurb: Big-hearted and proud of it; their table is always open. Old allies of the Nara and the Yamanaka.
akimichi.quarter: A compound with a big kitchen hall, by the market street

yamanaka.name: Yamanaka
yamanaka.blurb: Florists and sensors on the main street; the flower shop out front, a quiet hall behind. Old allies of the Nara and the Akimichi.
yamanaka.quarter: A compound on the main street, behind the flower shop

inuzuka.name: Inuzuka
inuzuka.blurb: Loud, loyal ninken handlers who live by the pack. Children get their first pup at the clan day.
inuzuka.technique: Fang over Fang, together with your ninken
inuzuka.quarter: Kennels and a clinic by the main gate

sarutobi.name: Sarutobi
sarutobi.blurb: An old council family that carries the Will of Fire: warm, stubborn, fond of long scarves.
sarutobi.technique: Fire mastery and the clan staff
sarutobi.quarter: A family house near the Residence with a fire-training yard

aburame.name: Aburame
aburame.blurb: Private, patient and precise; they share their bodies with the kikaichu insects and keep their faces behind lenses and collars.
aburame.technique: The insect swarm: it follows a target, drains chakra and marks it
aburame.quarter: A dark timber house with insect gardens

hatake.name: Hatake
hatake.blurb: A house almost empty; everyone respects the name, few visit. Silver hair and ninken run in the family.
hatake.technique: A ninken tracker and the chakra sabre
hatake.quarter: A lone, worn family house on a quiet lane

kurama.name: Kurama
kurama.blurb: A refined household of painters whose brushes make illusions. A polite rivalry with the Yuhi's school.
kurama.technique: Painted illusion: a genjutsu world closes over a target
kurama.quarter: A house with a painting studio on the old artists' lane

shimura.name: Shimura
shimura.blurb: A stern, quiet council family that keeps to itself. Disagrees with the Sarutobi about everything.
shimura.quarter: A stern house close to the Hokage Rock

yuhi.name: Yuhi
yuhi.blurb: The genjutsu clan of crimson eyes and old trees; their grove is a training ground for illusions.
yuhi.technique: Tree binding: the target sees itself bound while you step behind it
yuhi.quarter: A house in a grove of old trees, in the garden district

gekko.name: Gekko
gekko.blurb: A quiet family of swordsmen of the Crescent Moon: pale, tired-eyed, always with a blade at hand.
gekko.technique: Dance of the Crescent Moon: two short-lived clones strike with you
gekko.quarter: A kenjutsu dojo with a moon-viewing platform, by the training grounds

shiranui.name: Shiranui
shiranui.blurb: Cool-headed senbon specialists of the Hokage's guard, easy smiles and all.
shiranui.quarter: A family house near the gate barracks

morino.name: Morino
morino.blurb: Stern interrogators in long coats, and surprisingly gentle at home.
morino.quarter: A severe house near the police HQ

umino.name: Umino
umino.blurb: The teachers' family: half the village was taught by an Umino.
umino.quarter: Teachers' houses in the Academy streets

haruno.name: Haruno
haruno.blurb: A cheerful merchant household whose children became ninja.
haruno.quarter: A neat family house and garden on a residential street

namiashi.name: Namiashi
namiashi.blurb: Quiet swordsmen of the Hokage's guard, the wave-foot family.
namiashi.quarter: A small footwork dojo near the training grounds

hagane.name: Hagane
hagane.blurb: Gate guards and messengers, with a metalworker's shop beside the forge.
hagane.quarter: A metalworker's shop on the market street

kinoshita.name: Kinoshita
kinoshita.blurb: The carpenters and builders who raised and rebuilt the Leaf's houses; the furniture is made in their yard.

tsuchigumo.name: Tsuchigumo
tsuchigumo.blurb: A mountain shrine clan that lives in the Leaf but keeps its own counsel.
tsuchigumo.technique: Earth binding: earth-style ninjutsu and a web-like trap

suzuran.name: Suzuran
suzuran.blurb: Herbalists of the hospital gardens, with lily blood that shrugs off poison.
suzuran.technique: Herbalist: immune to poison, poultices and coatings at the workbench

tobari.name: Tobari
tobari.blurb: Silent scouts and night watchmen of the dark lanes behind the wall.
tobari.technique: Smothering: silence around you at night
